business_info.name: NovaByte Digital Studio
business_info.description: A digital agency that builds websites, online stores, mobile apps and business automations for small and medium businesses.

services.name: Business Website
services.description: Responsive 5-10 page website with contact forms, SEO basics and 1 month of support.

services.name: E-commerce Store
services.description: Online store (Shopify or WooCommerce) with payment gateway, product setup and order emails.

services.name: Mobile App
services.description: Cross-platform Android and iOS app built with React Native or Flutter.

services.name: WhatsApp Automation
services.description: WhatsApp Business API chatbot with AI replies, lead capture and CRM integration.

services.name: SEO & Digital Marketing
services.description: Monthly SEO, Google Business profile, social media ads management and reporting.

services.name: Website Maintenance Plan
services.description: Monthly updates, backups, security monitoring and small content changes.

faqs.question: What services do you offer?
faqs.answer: We build business websites, e-commerce stores, mobile apps, WhatsApp automations, and offer SEO/digital marketing and website maintenance plans.
faqs.keywords: services, offer, what do you do, help

faqs.question: What are your business hours?
faqs.answer: We are available Monday to Friday, 10:00 to 19:00 (Pakistan time). Messages sent outside these hours are answered by our AI assistant, and a team member follows up on the next working day.
faqs.keywords: hours, timing, open, available, weekend

faqs.question: How much does a website cost?
faqs.answer: A business website usually costs between 400 and 1,200 USD depending on the number of pages and features. We give an exact quote after understanding your requirements.
faqs.keywords: price, cost, website price, quote, charges, rate

faqs.question: How much does an online store cost?
faqs.answer: E-commerce stores usually cost between 900 and 3,000 USD depending on the platform, number of products and payment integrations.
faqs.keywords: ecommerce, shop, store, shopify, woocommerce, price

faqs.question: Do you require an advance payment?
faqs.answer: Yes. We usually take 50% in advance to start the project and 50% on delivery. Larger projects can be split into milestones.
faqs.keywords: advance, payment, deposit, installments, milestones

faqs.question: How long does it take to build a website?
faqs.answer: A standard business website takes 2 to 4 weeks. E-commerce stores take 3 to 6 weeks, and mobile apps usually 8 to 16 weeks.
faqs.keywords: time, duration, how long, timeline, delivery, deadline

faqs.question: What is your project process?
faqs.answer: 1) Free consultation call, 2) proposal and quote, 3) design approval, 4) development, 5) testing and your feedback, 6) launch and support.
faqs.keywords: process, steps, how do you work, workflow

faqs.question: Do you provide support after launch?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every project includes 1 month of free support. After that you can choose a maintenance plan starting from 50 USD per month.
faqs.keywords: support, maintenance, after delivery, bugs, updates

faqs.question: Can I see examples of your work?
faqs.answer: Yes! Our portfolio is on our website. Tell us your industry and we will share the most relevant examples.
faqs.keywords: portfolio, examples, previous work, samples, case study

faqs.question: Do you work with international clients?
faqs.answer: Yes, we work with clients worldwide. Meetings are held on Google Meet or Zoom and we accept international payments.
faqs.keywords: international, abroad, outside pakistan, remote, overseas

faqs.question: What can a WhatsApp automation do for my business?
faqs.answer: It can answer customer questions 24/7, capture leads, qualify them, send order updates, and hand complex chats to your team. Pricing starts from 600 USD.
faqs.keywords: whatsapp, chatbot, automation, bot, ai

faqs.question: How can I talk to a person?
faqs.answer: Just type 'talk to a human' and a team member will join this chat during business hours.
faqs.keywords: human, person, agent, call, representative, speak

faqs.question: Website kitne ki banti hai?
faqs.answer: Business website aam taur par 400 se 1,200 USD tak hoti hai, pages aur features par depend karta hai. Aap ki zaroorat samajh kar hum sahi quote dete hain.
faqs.keywords: website, qeemat, price, kitne, rate, kharcha, cost

faqs.question: Online store kitne ka banta hai?
faqs.answer: E-commerce store aam taur par 900 se 3,000 USD tak hota hai, platform aur products ki tadaad par depend karta hai.
faqs.keywords: online store, dukaan, shop, ecommerce, qeemat, kitne

faqs.question: Aap ke auqat-e-kaar kya hain?
faqs.answer: Hum Monday se Friday, subah 10 baje se shaam 7 baje tak (Pakistan time) available hain. Baqi waqt hamara AI assistant jawab deta hai.
faqs.keywords: auqat, timing, waqt, office, khula, band

faqs.question: Website banne mein kitna waqt lagta hai?
faqs.answer: Business website 2 se 4 hafte, online store 3 se 6 hafte aur mobile app aam taur par 8 se 16 hafte leti hai.
faqs.keywords: waqt, time, kitne din, hafte, delivery, kab tak

faqs.question: ویب سائٹ کی قیمت کیا ہے؟
faqs.answer: بزنس ویب سائٹ عام طور پر 400 سے 1,200 USD تک ہوتی ہے، جو صفحات اور فیچرز پر منحصر ہے۔ آپ کی ضرورت سمجھ کر ہم درست قیمت بتاتے ہیں۔
faqs.keywords: ویب سائٹ قیمت ریٹ خرچہ

faqs.question: آن لائن اسٹور کی قیمت کیا ہے؟
faqs.answer: ای کامرس اسٹور عام طور پر 900 سے 3,000 USD تک ہوتا ہے، جو پلیٹ فارم اور پروڈکٹس کی تعداد پر منحصر ہے۔
faqs.keywords: آن لائن اسٹور دکان قیمت

faqs.question: آپ کے اوقاتِ کار کیا ہیں؟
faqs.answer: ہم پیر سے جمعہ، صبح 10 بجے سے شام 7 بجے تک (پاکستان وقت) دستیاب ہیں۔ باقی وقت ہمارا AI اسسٹنٹ جواب دیتا ہے۔
faqs.keywords: اوقات وقت ٹائمنگ دفتر

faqs.question: ویب سائٹ بننے میں کتنا وقت لگتا ہے؟
faqs.answer: بزنس ویب سائٹ 2 سے 4 ہفتے، آن لائن اسٹور 3 سے 6 ہفتے اور موبائل ایپ عام طور پر 8 سے 16 ہفتے لیتی ہے۔
faqs.keywords: وقت ہفتے ڈیلیوری کب
